  fleet check
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
Usage: fleet check [-h] [machine]

Fetch new update results.
Status reads saved results; check fetches new results.
Fetch manager and content upstreams quietly, with a 10-second limit per fetch.
An upstream is the remote branch tracked by a checkout, a local Git copy.
Save both results only when both checks succeed.
SSH securely connects to another machine.
Add MACHINE to use one registered machine and its own saved choices.
Remote runs never prompt; connection failures exit nonzero.

positional arguments:
  machine     one registered machine; omit to use this machine

options:
  -h, --help  show this help message and exit

Exit codes:
  0  Manager and content are current.
  1  Updates are available.
  2  Could not check updates, or invalid arguments.
  130  Interrupted.

Examples:
  fleet check
